description: Sector overlay for agricultural producers, processors, exporters, importers, food-chain participants, and agribusiness documentation in the United States.

metadata.scope: United States-only sector overlay controls for Agriculture. Intended to be used with core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis revalidated against authoritative U.S. federal statutes, regulations, agency and regulator materials, and applicable model/professional or industry standards available through 2026-08-30. This rule pack remains an evidence-screening control set, not legal advice, and requires qualified legal/compliance review before production reliance. State, territorial, tribal, and local requirements may impose additional obligations.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act and Food Traceability Rule materials
USDA National Organic Program / Strengthening Organic Enforcement

rules.title: APHIS animal/plant health permit or quarantine evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for APHIS permits, quarantine, animal health, plant health, import/export, or pest/disease controls.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.

rules.title: Agricultural product traceability or sanitary transport evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for lot-level traceability, traceability-plan/KDE/CTE records where the Food Traceability Rule applies, sanitary transportation, supply-chain verification, recall, and recordkeeping controls. FDA is directed not to enforce the Food Traceability Rule before July 20, 2028.
